sonnet.problem: The card says God is 'not asking about a table or a door' and is asking 'just one plain, everyday job.' Verse 3 asks generally whether vine wood can make 'something useful,' and then asks about a peg. A table or a door would count as something useful, so the card adds a limit the text doesn't give and shrinks two questions into one.
sonnet.rule: **Don't stretch the text.** Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
